account.disabledNoIssue: The account "{account}" is disabled, so nothing is issued on its behalf.
account.nobodyCalled: There is nobody called "{name}" in this realm's directory. In product mode every referenced object must exist first.
account.realmRetiring: The trust realm "{realm}" is being removed, so nothing new is signed in or issued in it.
account.realmRetiringInterrupted: The trust realm "{realm}" was being removed from {since}, and that removal was interrupted before it finished — the process doing it stopped. Nothing new is signed in or issued in it until an administrator finishes the removal.
account.realmRetiringSince: The trust realm "{realm}" is being removed (the removal began at {since}), so nothing new is signed in or issued in it.
authn.accountNoLongerSignedIn: That account is no longer signed in here. Choose it again to sign in, or choose another.
authn.accountNotRemembered: That account is not one this browser remembers.
authn.accountSessionEnded: That account's session has just ended. Choose it again to sign in, or choose another.
authn.accountStillSignedIn: That account is still signed in. Sign it out first; only a signed-out account can be forgotten.
authn.accountsChanged: The accounts in this browser changed in another tab. Choose again.
authn.accountsFull: This browser is already signed in to {count} accounts, the most it may hold. Sign out of one of them first.
authn.accountsUnread: This browser's accounts could not be read just now. Try again in a moment.
authn.afterStepGone: This step after signing in has expired or does not exist. Start the request again from the application that sent you here.
authn.apiBadLimit: The limit {limit} is not a string or a list of strings of a reasonable size.
authn.apiCsrf: The {header} header is missing or is not this browser's. Load the sign-in page again.
authn.apiJsonOnly: This operation takes a JSON body (Content-Type: application/json).
authn.apiNoAccountChoice: There is no sign-in waiting on an account choice under that id, or it has expired. Start the request again from the application that sent you here.
authn.apiNoSession: This browser holds no session for this sign-in. Load the sign-in page again.
authn.apiNoSignIn: There is no sign-in waiting under that id, or it has expired. Start the request again from the application that sent you here.
authn.apiNotAStepPage: That is not a page of a sign-in step.
authn.apiNotConsentId: That is not the id of a consent.
authn.apiNotPasswordChangeId: That is not the id of a password change.
authn.apiNotSignInId: That is not the id of a sign-in.
authn.apiOrigin: This operation is sent by a page of this service: the request carried {origin, select, other {another origin} none {no Origin}}.
authn.apiOtherBrowser: That sign-in was started in another browser.
authn.apiSessionCap: This realm is holding as many sign-in sessions as it allows, so no new one can start in this browser now. Try again later.
authn.apiUnknownField: The body has a field this operation does not take: {field}.
authn.applicationNoPasskey: This application does not allow a passkey sign-in.
authn.authenticatorAppNotSetUp: The authenticator app could not be set up.
authn.authenticatorAppsOff: Authenticator apps cannot be set up in this realm.
authn.browserAnswerUnreadable: The browser returned something this server could not read.
authn.browserNoCeremonySignIn: Your browser did not run the ceremony. Signing in with a passkey needs JavaScript — a passkey is used by the browser and no form can do it. Allow scripts for this page, or type your username.
authn.browserNoCeremonyStep: Your browser did not run the ceremony. This step needs JavaScript — a passkey is used by the browser and no form can do it. Allow scripts for this page and try again.
authn.browserNoPasskey: Your browser did not use a passkey ({error}).
authn.certificateNone: No verified client certificate arrived on this connection, so there is nobody to continue as. Choose the certificate when your browser asks, or sign in another way.
authn.certificateNotAPerson: This certificate is not a TLS client certificate for a person here, so it cannot sign you in.
authn.certificateNotOffered: Signing in with a certificate is not offered for this sign-in.
authn.certificateNotStored: Your certificate is not stored on any account here, so it cannot sign you in. Ask an administrator to store it on your account (a renewed certificate is stored again), or sign in another way.
authn.certificateOfApplication: This certificate was issued to an application, and an application's certificate signs nobody in.
authn.certificateOtherRealm: Your certificate was issued in another realm, so it cannot sign you in here.
authn.certificateRevoked: Your certificate has been revoked, or its revocation could not be confirmed, so it cannot sign you in.
authn.certificateStoredTwice: Your certificate is stored on more than one account here, so it cannot say which one is yours. Ask an administrator to store it on yours alone.
authn.certificateUnavailable: Signing in with a certificate is not available here.
authn.choosePasskeyFirst: Choose one of your passkeys first.
authn.chooseSecondFactorFirst: Choose a second factor to set up first.
authn.codeUncheckedTryAgain: That code could not be checked. Try again.
authn.codeUncheckedTryNext: That code could not be checked. Try the next one.
authn.enterUsername: Enter a username. It does not have to exist — it is the identity the issued tokens will describe.
authn.hardwarePasskeyNone: This sign-in asks for a hardware-protected phishing-resistant passkey, and none of the passkeys held for this step can earn it. A synced passkey, or one whose attestation is not trusted, is not enough.
authn.keyAloneAccountNeedsTwo: A second factor is required for this account, and a security key on its own is one factor. Sign in with your password; you will be asked for your second factor, or to set one up.
authn.keyAloneRealmNeedsTwo: A second factor is required in this realm, and a security key on its own is one factor. Sign in with your password; you will be asked for your second factor, or to set one up.
authn.keyDemanded: This sign-in demands a passkey, and {what, select, recovery {a recovery code} other {a one-time code}} does not answer that. Use your passkey on the previous screen.
authn.linkNeedsPassword: Linking an account signs in with its password — and its second factor, where it has one — so a security key on its own is not offered here.
authn.linkNoPasskeyAlone: Linking an account signs in with its password, so a passkey on its own is not offered here.
authn.newPasswordNotAccepted: The new password was not accepted.
authn.noAuthenticatorApp: No authenticator app is enrolled for that account, so there is no code to ask for.
authn.noClassicalPasskeyLeft: There is no classical passkey to upgrade any more.
authn.noPasskeyRegistered: There is no passkey registered for signing in to this account. Sign in with your password, then add a passkey at /portal/keys.
authn.noPasswordStep: There is no sign-in waiting for a password as its second factor. Start the request again from the application that sent you here.
authn.noRecoveryCodes: No recovery codes have been issued for that account, so there is nothing to ask for.
authn.noSecondFactorPasskey: No passkey is registered as a second factor for that account.
authn.passkeyAloneNotTwo: This request asked for a second factor, so a passkey on its own cannot answer it — one factor is one factor. Sign in with a password and the passkey together.
authn.passkeyBeforeUsernameless: This passkey was registered before passkeys could sign in without a username. Type your username to use it, or register it again at /portal/keys.
authn.passkeyCouldNotSignIn: That passkey could not sign you in.
authn.passkeyNameNotUsername: That is the name your password manager shows for a post-quantum passkey, not a username. Type your username without the part after the "+".
authn.passkeyNeededNoneHeld: This request needs a passkey, and this account holds none. Add one at /portal/keys and sign in again.
authn.passkeyNotRecorded: The passkey could not be recorded. Try again.
authn.passkeyNotUpgradable: The passkey could not be upgraded.
authn.passkeyRequestExpired: That passkey request has expired. Try again.
authn.passkeyRulesUnchecked: This passkey could not be checked against this realm's rules. Try again.
authn.passkeyUncheckedUnchanged: The passkey could not be checked. Your passkey is unchanged; try again.
authn.passkeysOffNoRegistration: Passkeys are switched off in this realm (webauthn.enabled), so a new one cannot be registered here. A passkey already registered goes on working.
authn.passwordNotFirstFactor: This realm does not accept a password as a first factor. Use one of the other ways of signing in below.
authn.passwordReserved: That password is reserved and is refused at every sign-in, so it cannot be yours.
authn.passwordsDiffer: The two passwords are not the same.
authn.policyRefusedSession: The issuance policy refused this session.
authn.postLoginNotSkippable: The time allowed for this has passed, so it cannot be skipped any more. Register the passkey to finish signing in.
authn.postLoginOverdueHere: Before you can sign in this way you have to register a post-quantum passkey, and the time allowed for it has passed. Sign in at this service's sign-in screen, where you will be asked to register it.
authn.postLoginStepHeld: You have to complete a step after signing in. Start the request again from the application that sent you here.
authn.postQuantumOnlyStep: This step registers a post-quantum passkey only; a classical one cannot be made here.
authn.productNoPrimaryKey: This service is in product mode, where a passkey that signs in on its own is added at /portal/keys after signing in, never at the sign-in screen.
authn.productNoSuchPerson: This service is in product mode, where a passkey can only be registered for somebody who already exists. Create the person first.
authn.recoveryCodesSpent: Every recovery code on that account has been used. A set is issued once and is never topped up, so an administrator has to clear it before a new one can be issued.
authn.roleExclusive: At most one of these roles may be chosen together.
authn.roleLapsed: A role chosen is no longer available. Choose again.
authn.roleNotChoosableHere: This application needs you to choose a role when you sign in, which cannot be done this way. Sign in at this service's sign-in screen.
authn.roleNotOffered: A role was chosen that this sign-in did not offer.
authn.roleRequiredLeftOut: This sign-in needs at least one of its required roles.
authn.rolesAfterSignIn: You have to choose your roles after signing in. Start the request again from the application that sent you here.
authn.rpIdMismatch: webauthn.rpId is "{rpId}", which is neither the host this request reached ("{host}") nor a registrable domain suffix of it, and in product mode a security-key ceremony is not run against an address the configuration did not name. Reach this service at a host under "{rpId}", or set global.publicBaseUrl to one.
authn.secondFactorAlreadySetUp: A second factor is already set up for this account. Start the request again from the application that sent you here and sign in with it.
authn.secondFactorCheckFailed: The second factor did not verify; this check failed: {checks}.
authn.secondFactorDemandUnmet: This sign-in needs a second factor that this application does not accept, or one you have not set up. Ask an administrator.
authn.secondFactorNoneAvailable: A second factor is needed and none that this realm accepts is available for this account.
authn.secondFactorNoneForApplication: A second factor is required, and none that this application accepts can be set up here. Ask an administrator.
authn.secondFactorNoneInRealm: A second factor is required for this account and none can be set up here: authenticator apps and security keys are both switched off in this realm. Ask an administrator.
authn.secondFactorNoneToEnrol: This application accepts a second factor you have not set up, and none that it accepts can be set up here. Ask an administrator.
authn.secondFactorNotOptional: A second factor is required for this account; it cannot be ignored.
authn.secondFactorUnchecked: The second factor could not be checked: {detail}
authn.secondFactorUncheckedAgain: The second factor could not be checked. Try again.
authn.securityKeysOff: Security keys cannot be set up in this realm.
authn.setUpExpired: That set-up expired before it was confirmed. Start it again.
authn.setUpGone: This second-factor set-up has expired or does not exist. Start the request again from the application that sent you here.
authn.stepEnded: This sign-in step has already ended. Start the request again from the application that sent you here.
authn.stepExpired: This second-factor step has expired. Start the request again from the application that sent you here.
authn.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait {seconds} seconds and try again.
authn.tooManyFailedAttempts: Too many failed attempts. Wait {seconds} seconds and try again.
authn.upgradeExpired: This passkey upgrade has expired. Start over to sign in again; you will be asked again.
authn.usernamelessOnly: This application signs in with a passkey and no username. Use Sign in with a passkey.
authn.walletOtherPerson: The credential your wallet presented was issued to somebody other than the person whose password was entered, so neither is signed in.
authn.walletStepExpired: This second-factor step has expired. Start the request again from the application.
authn.walletTwice: The first factor of this sign-in was already a wallet, and one key proved twice is one factor. Use your authenticator app, your passkey or your password.
authn.webauthnError: {error} (WebAuthn reports one error for several situations, so this does not say which.)
factor.backupMismatch: That is not one of your recovery codes.
factor.backupNoneFor: No recovery codes have been issued for {name}.
factor.backupShape: A recovery code is letters and digits only — the ones this service printed for you, in groups. Dashes and spaces are ignored.
factor.backupSpent: That recovery code has already been used. Each one works once — use the next unused code on your list.
factor.backupUnreadable: Your recovery codes cannot be read by this service, so they cannot be checked. An administrator has to clear them on your row under /admin/users.
factor.backupUnrecorded: That code is right and this service could not record that it has been used, so it was not accepted. Try another one, and tell an administrator.
factor.codeUncheckedAgain: That code could not be checked just now. Try again in a moment.
factor.codeUncheckedNext: That code could not be checked just now. Try the next one in a moment.
factor.hotpMismatch: That code is not right. If your token has been pressed many times without signing in, resynchronise it with two codes in a row.
factor.hotpNoneFor: No one-time code token is enrolled for {name}.
factor.hotpReplay: That code has already been used. Press your token again for a new one.
factor.hotpResyncMismatch: Those two codes are not consecutive codes of this token within {window} presses. Press it twice more and enter both codes.
factor.hotpResyncShape: Resynchronising takes two codes of {digits} digits, one after the other.
factor.hotpUnreadable: Your one-time code token cannot be read by this service, so it cannot be checked. An administrator has to clear it.
factor.hotpUnreadableShort: Your one-time code token cannot be read by this service.
factor.nameControlCharacter: The name holds a control character, so no person has it. Nothing was started.
factor.secretUnreadable: The stored shared secret could not be read.
factor.totpEnrolExpired: That enrolment has expired. Start again and scan the new code.
factor.totpMismatch: That code is not right, or it has expired.
factor.totpNoName: There is no name to enrol an authenticator for.
factor.totpNoStore: No credential store is installed, so an authenticator app cannot be enrolled.
factor.totpNoneFor: No authenticator app is enrolled for {name}.
factor.totpOff: Authenticator apps are turned off on this service (the authentication policy).
factor.totpReplay: That code has already been used. Wait for your authenticator to show the next one.
factor.totpUnreadable: Your authenticator enrolment cannot be read by this service, so it cannot be checked. An administrator has to clear it on your row under /admin/users and you can enrol again.
factor.yubiNoneFor: No YubiKey OTP is enrolled for {name}.
factor.yubiNotDecrypted: That OTP does not decrypt under the key enrolled here.
factor.yubiOtherKey: That OTP was not made by the YubiKey enrolled here.
factor.yubiReplay: That one-time password has already been used. Touch the key again.
factor.yubiShape: That is not a YubiKey OTP. Touch the key and enter the whole string it types.
factor.yubiUnchecked: That one-time password could not be checked just now. Touch the key again in a moment.
factor.yubiUnreadable: Your YubiKey OTP cannot be read by this service, so it cannot be checked. An administrator has to clear it.
factor.yubiZeroCounter: That OTP carries a zero counter, which this service does not accept. Touch the key again.
passkey.attestationAlgorithm: {at, select, registration {That passkey's attestation } other {This passkey was registered with an attestation that }}{state, select, untrusted {{at, select, registration {is not one this service verified and trusts} other {this service did not verify and trust}}} nocert {carries no certificate} unrecorded {is signed with algorithms never recorded} other {is signed with {signed}}}, and this realm requires one signed with {anyRequired, select, no {nothing} other {{required}}} (the passkey policy's attestationAlgorithms). {at, select, registration {Use an authenticator whose attestation is signed that way.} other {Sign in another way, and register a passkey whose attestation is.}}
passkey.backupEligible: That passkey can be synced or backed up (its authenticator set the backup-eligible flag), and this realm accepts only device-bound passkeys (the passkey policy's backupEligibility is disallow). {at, select, registration {Use a security key, or a passkey kept on this device only.} other {Sign in another way, and register a device-bound key.}}
passkey.credProtect: That passkey protects its credential at level {level}{note, select, unattested { (its attestation is not trusted, so the level it reported is not proof, and counts as level 1)} unreported { (it reported no credential protection, which is level 1)} other {}}, and this realm requires level {required} (the passkey policy's credProtect, enforced). Use a security key that supports CTAP 2.1 credential protection.
passkey.enrolmentOff: Passkeys are switched off in this realm (webauthn.enabled). A passkey already registered goes on being listed; no new one can be registered.
passkey.enrolmentUseless: This realm accepts a passkey neither as a way to sign in on its own nor as a second factor (webauthn.primaryAllowed, webauthn.mfaAllowed and the authentication policy), so a new one could never be used.
passkey.issuancePolicy: This realm's issuance policy {at, select, registration {does not let that passkey be registered here.} other {no longer lets that passkey sign you in. Sign in another way.}}
passkey.laneClassicalOnly: The passkey policy offers classical passkeys only here (registrationMode is classical-only), so a post-quantum one cannot be created. A post-quantum passkey already registered goes on working.
passkey.laneNoMlDsa: This service can verify no ML-DSA algorithm, so a post-quantum passkey cannot be created.
passkey.laneNotAlongside: A post-quantum passkey beside a classical one is not offered in this realm (webauthn.pqcAlongsideClassical{pqcOnly, select, yes {, and webauthn.pqcOnly is on} other {}}). A post-quantum passkey already registered goes on working.
passkey.notALane: A passkey is created in the "classical" lane or the "pqc" lane. "{lane}" is neither.
passkey.notPrimary: A passkey cannot sign anybody in on its own in this realm (webauthn.primaryAllowed). Sign in with a password, and your passkey is asked for next where the realm allows it.
passkey.notSecondFactor: A passkey cannot be a second factor in this realm (webauthn.mfaAllowed). An authenticator app is the other one, where the authentication policy allows it.
passkey.off: Passkeys are switched off in this realm (webauthn.enabled).
passkey.pinLengthShort: That passkey accepts a PIN of {value} characters, and this realm requires at least {min} (the passkey policy's minPinLength). {at, select, registration {Use a key configured with a longer minimum PIN.} other {Sign in another way, and register a key whose minimum PIN is long enough.}}
passkey.pinLengthUnreported: That passkey did not report its minimum PIN length, and this realm requires a PIN of at least {min} characters (the passkey policy's enforcePinLength). A security key reports it only to services it was configured to tell. {at, select, registration {Use a key configured with a longer minimum PIN.} other {Sign in another way, and register a key whose minimum PIN is long enough.}}
passkey.postQuantum: That passkey signs with {known, select, no {a classical algorithm} other {{algorithm}}}, and this realm requires a post-quantum passkey, one that signs with ML-DSA (the passkey policy's postQuantumRequired is {setting}). {at, select, registration {Use an authenticator that can make an ML-DSA passkey.} other {Sign in another way, and register a post-quantum passkey.}}
passkey.profileAlgorithm: That passkey signs with {known, select, no {an algorithm never recorded} other {{algorithm}}}, which is not one the passkey policy offers here (profile {profile}: {anyOffered, select, no {nothing} other {{offered}}}, registrationMode {mode}). Use an authenticator that can make one of those.
passkey.recoveryEnrolFirst: This account was recovered without its passkey, and this realm lets it reach no application until a passkey has signed you in (the passkey policy's recoveryAssurance). Register a new passkey, then sign in with it.
passkey.recoverySelfService: This account is protected by a passkey, and this realm lets it be recovered only by whoever manages it (the passkey policy's recoveryAssurance is operator-only). Sign in with your passkey, or ask an administrator for a reset or activation link.
passkey.retryPqOnlyProfile: The passkey policy offers post-quantum (ML-DSA) passkeys only here (registrationMode is pq-only), so a classical one cannot be made instead. Use a device or a security key that can make an ML-DSA passkey.
passkey.retryPqcOnly: This realm requests post-quantum (ML-DSA) passkeys only (webauthn.pqcOnly), so a classical one cannot be made instead. Use a device or a security key that can make an ML-DSA passkey.
passkey.retryRequiredRegistration: The passkey policy requires a post-quantum (ML-DSA) passkey at registration (postQuantumRequired is registration-and-sign-in), so a classical one cannot be made instead. Use a device or a security key that can make an ML-DSA passkey.
passkey.retryRequiredSignIn: The passkey policy requires a post-quantum (ML-DSA) passkey to sign in here (postQuantumRequired), so a classical one made now would not sign you in. Use a device or a security key that can make an ML-DSA passkey.
passkey.serialMissing: That security key's attestation names no device serial this service can read, and this realm binds security keys to the serials issued to each person (the passkey policy's enterpriseSerialAttribute). Use a key from your organisation, registered where enterprise attestation is enabled.
passkey.serialNotHeld: That security key (serial {serial}) is not one issued to you: its serial is not on your directory entry ({attribute}). Use the key your organisation issued you.
passkey.u2fNotAccepted: That security key was imported from a U2F service this realm no longer accepts (webauthn.u2fAppIds).
passkey.u2fNotAlone: That security key was imported from a U2F service and cannot verify who you are, so it cannot sign you in on its own. Use it after your password.
passkey.upgradeNoMlDsa: This service can verify no ML-DSA algorithm, so a passkey cannot be upgraded to one.
passkey.upgradeOff: Passkeys are switched off in this realm (webauthn.enabled), so none can be upgraded.
passkey.usernamelessNotPrimary: A passkey may not sign anybody in on its own in this realm (webauthn.primaryAllowed).
passkey.usernamelessOff: Signing in with a passkey and no username is switched off in this realm (the passkey policy's allowUsernameless, on Directory → Policies).
password.breached: That password has appeared in a data breach, so people trying stolen passwords will try it. Choose a different one.
password.missing: Give a password. To take one away, remove the {attribute} attribute from the entry.
password.policy: That password does not meet this realm's password policy, which asks for {short, select, yes {at least {min} characters (it has {length})} other {}}{both, select, yes {, } other {}}{hasWord, select, yes {no word this organization or service is known by (it contains "{word}")} other {}}. The rules are on /admin/policies (profile "{profile}").
password.reused: That password has been used for this account recently. This realm's password policy refuses the current password and the {history} before it (profile "{profile}"). Choose one you have not used here.
password.rotates: {account} is a service account whose password rotates through its push destination, so it cannot be set by hand: the destination is where its consumers read it. Use Rotate now on its page, or POST /admin-api/users/rotate-password.
policy.compliantDeviceRequired: A compliant registered device is required.
policy.deviceBoundPending: The application requires a device-bound session, and registration for this one has not finished.
policy.deviceBoundRefused: The application requires a device-bound session, and this one {fact, select, skipped {was skipped.} other {was not bound in time.}}
policy.indeterminate: the issuance policy could not be evaluated{anyStatus, select, yes {: {status}} other {}}. Nothing is issued on an Indeterminate, because the alternative is issuing on an error.
policy.mechanismRequired: This application requires signing in with {mechanisms}.
policy.noIssuanceDecision: No issuance decision could be made.
policy.otherRuleDenied: the issuance policy denied it with a rule other than the role requirement: "{application}" requires {required}, which {named, select, yes {"{who}"} other {the caller}} holds. {anyCarried, select, yes {The Deny carried {carried}.} other {The Deny carried no obligation naming the rule; /admin/xacml/decide shows which rule applies.}}
policy.passkeyNotFirstFactor: This realm's authentication policy does not accept a passkey as a first factor. Sign in with what it does accept.
policy.passkeyNotFirstFactorShort: This realm's authentication policy does not accept a passkey as a first factor.
policy.passkeyNotSecondFactor: This realm's authentication policy does not accept a passkey as a second factor.
policy.phishingResistance: "{application}" requires {lacked, select, hardware-protected {a phishing-resistant authentication with a hardware-protected key (OpenID Connect EAP ACR Values 1.0, phrh)} other {a phishing-resistant authentication (OpenID Connect EAP ACR Values 1.0, phr)}}, and {named, select, yes {"{who}"} other {the caller}}'s was not one. A passkey or security key already registered meets phr; phrh needs one whose attestation this realm trusts and that is not backup-eligible.
policy.protocolNotConfigured: The application is not configured for this protocol.
policy.roleRequired: "{application}" requires {anyRequired, select, yes {{required}} other {a role nothing named}} and {named, select, yes {"{who}"} other {the caller}} holds {anyHeld, select, yes {{held}} other {no role at all}}.
policy.secondFactorRequired: This application requires the second factor {factors}.
web.answeredNoJson: The service answered {status} with no JSON.
web.noOperation: This control has no API operation ({control}), so the page refuses it rather than guess.
web.noState: The service sent no state for it.
web.noStepToRestart: This page names no sign-in step to start over from.
web.notDrawnTitle: This page could not be drawn
web.unreachable: The service's API could not be reached.
